summary: Backend testing for MIS PDF Emissions Overview 4 bug fixes (iter153). All 7 new tests + 28 regression tests pass. Verified: (1) PDF now contains 'GHG Emissions' master heading and 'Total Emissions' sub-section, (2) Scope 3 composition contains all 15 canonical categories C1-C15, (3) trend lines break at None (segmented plotting in _render_labeled_trend), (4) FY/CY annual records are distributed across constituent months — scope3.current_value went from 0 (previous iter) to 27.5 tCO2e for reporting_period 2026-08 confirming the distribution logic works. Also verified _period_to_months parses CY2025 → 12 months from 2025-01, and FY 2025-2026 → 12 months from 2025-04 to 2026-03. emissions_deep.months has exactly 13 entries; total.current_value (67.02) equals sum of scope1(38.12)+scope2(1.41)+scope3(27.5)+biogenic(0).
critical_code_review_comments: pdfplumber was not in backend/requirements.txt but is used by the new test — installed at runtime. If tests should run in fresh envs, main agent may want to add pdfplumber to test-requirements or make the test rely only on structural checks.

service.py is now 1222 lines — approaching the recommended split threshold. Consider moving SCOPE3_CANONICAL, _period_to_months and build_emissions_deep_data into a dedicated emissions_deep.py submodule for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New test file /app/backend/tests/test_mis_emissions_deep_iter153.py covers all 4 iter153 bug fixes. Uses reporting_period 2026-08. Requires pdfplumber (pip install pdfplumber). All 28 pre-existing tests in test_executive_summary_insights.py + test_mis_reporting_period_service.py still pass — no regression.
